name: TopCoat Icons
about: TopCoat Icons is a free, open-source icon set with 89 icons designed by TopCoat. From navigation and actions to files, media and communication, it covers everyday UI needs. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under Apache 2.0.

faqs.q: Are TopCoat Icons free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All 89 TopCoat Icons are open source under the Apache 2.0 license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the Apache 2.0 terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: How do I use TopCoat Icons in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.

faqs.q: How many TopCoat Icons are there?
faqs.a: There are 89 icons in the TopCoat Icons set, designed by TopCoat. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: Can I change the color and size of TopCoat Icons?
faqs.a: Yes. Open any icon, pick a size and color, and the preview updates instantly. SVG, PNG and WebP exports follow your choices, and React snippets recolor through props.

faqs.q: What formats are TopCoat Icons available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
